I opened one of today's two accounts. The other is on hold until we can verify the relative who would own the money.

**L-2449, Vaysal Demirel (C-86101): opened.** His identity check came back verified, so I opened the Everyday Current Account (A-AB0FDF) and posted the M$5,900 initial deposit. It's under the M$10,000 threshold, so no large-cash report was needed.

**L-1336, Liz Santos (C-64409): on hold.** The call notes say her relative abroad, Av. Merim Zerafet Tevetoğlu, would fund and run the account while she holds the card. That makes the relative the real owner of the money. Policy (§6) says we must verify that person before opening and can't open the account in her name to get around this. Her identity check came back incomplete because we don't have the relative's ID or a signed owner declaration.
- I've asked her for both documents, and she expects to send them in about 6 business days. That's after the quarter ends on Thursday, so this account won't open this quarter.
- When the documents arrive, we'll need to re-run the check and confirm where the relative's money comes from.

I've closed the shift and left a handover note covering both leads.
